name: pastel-outbound
description: A complete outbound team in 17 skills: find buying-intent leads, filter, research, score, write LinkedIn copy, warm up on posts, launch sequences, triage replies, qualify meetings, and report what converts — powered by the Pastel MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Your outbound team in 17 skills, powered by Pastel
interface.longDescription: Find people showing buying intent on LinkedIn, filter them against your ICP, research one angle each, score them, write copy that doesn't sound like AI, warm them up on their posts, queue sequences, triage replies, and learn what converts. Nothing is sent without your review by default.
defaultPrompt: Find 25 people who match my ICP and showed buying intent this week. Don't contact anyone yet.
